mapper.select: UPDATE candidate_ai_profiles AS cp SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = cp.attempt_count + 1, deadline_at = #{deadline}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} FROM resumes AS r WHERE cp.id = #{profileId} AND cp.resume_id = #{resumeId} AND cp.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND cp.resume_id = r.id AND r.user_id = #{candidateId} AND cp.is_deleted = FALSE AND r.is_deleted = FALSE AND cp.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ( cp.status = 'PENDING' OR ( cp.status = 'PROCESSING' AND (cp.deadline_at IS NULL OR cp.deadline_at <= #{now}) ) ) RETURNING cp.id AS profile_id, cp.resume_id, cp.candidate_id, r.resume_text, cp.attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_ai_profiles SET status = 'COMPLETED', summary_json = CAST(#{summaryJson} AS JSONB), llm_config_snapshot = CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS JSONB), deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, analyzed_at = #{now}, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{profileId} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = FALSE
